who: King Roald Remanis III rules Misthalin from the throne room of Varrock Palace, with his Saradominist advisor Aeonisig at his elbow and Queen Ellamaria very much in charge of him. He is pompous, busy, easily affronted and slow to spend money or send soldiers, but he means well and rather enjoys being king.

address: "citizen" by default ("Yes, citizen. Do you need something?"); "peasant" when crossed ("Lead on, peasant"); "adventurer" in rare gratitude ("Many thanks, adventurer!").
grammar: formal, complete sentences with few contractions
refers to himself as the King and treats questions as impertinence
exclamations of the court: "My goodness!", "Good heavens", "For Saradomin's sake!"
dismissals tacked on the end: "Now, run along.", "Now off you go!"
rhythm: Pompous and brisk: one self-important sentence, then a dismissal. Huffs when contradicted, cheers up fast when flattered.
